blockers_and_next_steps: Retained Foldseek rows do not prove absence of all same-fingerprint structural neighbors; they are a pilot proxy until a full nearest-neighbor Foldseek table is emitted.
Rows with high active-site geometry top1 scores but no retained same-fingerprint Foldseek neighbors are good calibration targets for future PLM and hybrid models.
Absent ESM-2 150M, ProtT5, SaProt, 3Di-token, and ESM-C row-level prediction artifacts block cross-model orphan conclusions today.

pilot_summary.interpretation_guardrail: A correct confident transfer on a near-orphan row is informative, but calibrated abstention is preferred over wrong confident transfer when same-fingerprint structural support is weak or absent.
